notes: The verse writes no waw at all, so the *And* opening the second colon is `added` (rule 14's closing sentences, rule 30).
`תַהְפֻּכוֹת רָע` is a genuine construct chain (Ncfpc + Aamsa), so the construct takes the supplied *the* and the rectum takes the *of* (rules 29 and 19).
The marginal note *Or, the evil man* was read and set aside (rule 38).
